h2: Pool Cleaning Canggu – One-Off Service & Green Pool Recovery
intro: Most villas across Canggu went up quickly from former rice paddies, and pool equipment often needs attention within the first few years. Our Pool Cleaning Canggu service handles everything from a quick pre-guest tidy-up to full green-water recovery, so you don't have to juggle multiple trades for one job.

sections.h3: Why Pools Here Need More Attention Than You'd Think
sections.text: Canggu grew from paddies into villa streets almost overnight, and the ground still remembers. The high water table that once fed rice now pushes moisture through septic lines and underpool drainage, while heavy monsoon rain floods gardens and overflows pump rooms. In Pererenan, leaves from surrounding fields land daily, clogging skimmers and turning water cloudy within days if nobody's watching. Most call-outs here aren't about neglect—they're about keeping pace with the environment.

sections.h3: What a One-Off Visit Actually Covers
sections.text: A standard clean includes skimming the surface, brushing walls and steps, vacuuming the floor, backwashing the filter unit, and testing plus adjusting chlorine, pH and alkalinity. If the water has gone green or milky, we add a recovery step: shock treatment, extended filtration cycles and re-testing before you hand keys to guests. Waterline tile staining from hard local water is part of the brush-down too. One visit, one balanced pool—no piecing together three different trades.

Send two or three photos on WhatsApp: a wide shot showing overall water colour, a close-up of the filter or pump room, and any visible staining or debris. Mention where you are—Babakan, for instance—and roughly when you'd like it done. We'll reply with what the job looks like and a quote based on those images. There's no fixed rate list; pricing depends entirely on condition and access, so a quick photo exchange saves everyone time.

sections.h3: Keeping Your Pool Clear Between Visits
sections.text: Before the wet season hits, clear silt out of your overflow drain—Canggu's former paddy soil is fine-grained and clogs fast. Make sure the pump sits above flood level; streets in Batu Bolong can run underfoot after a hard downpour. Skim daily during leafy weeks, keep the filter running at least eight hours a day, and test chlorine every two to three days if guests use the pool regularly.

faq.q: How long does a green pool recovery take?
faq.a: It depends on how far the algae has progressed, but most single visits include shock treatment and extended filtration, with a re-test before we sign off.

faq.q: Do you cover villas outside the main Canggu strip?
faq.a: Yes, our route reaches all of Canggu including quieter lanes in Babakan and Padonan. Just send a couple of photos on WhatsApp and we'll confirm access.

faq.q: Can I book a clean the morning before guests arrive?
faq.a: If the water is already reasonably clear, a standard one-off visit fits into a half-day window. For green or heavily stained pools, allow at least two days so the chemistry can settle properly.
